content.title: Project Apex — Core Backend Payments & Multi-Currency Settlement Engine
content.summary: Expanded scope mutually agreed by Acme Corp and Mili Nair to include real-time UPI reconciliation and multi-currency FX settlement.

features.name: Idempotent Double-Entry Ledger Core
features.description: ACID-compliant payment state machine handling 5,000 TPS with zero duplicate settlements.

features.name: Cryptographic Webhook Dispatcher
features.description: HMAC-SHA256 signed merchant payout notifications with exponential retry queues.

features.name: Real-Time UPI & Multi-Currency FX Reconciliation
features.description: Automated T+0 settlement reconciliation engine across INR, USD, and SGD Nostro accounts.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Zero reconciliation drift across 1M synthetic transactions

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Double-Entry Ledger & Settlement API
milestones.deliverables: Go ledger service, PostgreSQL schema migrations, load test suite

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Webhook Dispatcher & Production Cutover
milestones.deliverables: Signed webhook worker, Prometheus telemetry, runbook documentation

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Multi-Currency FX & UPI Reconciliation Module
milestones.deliverables: FX settlement router, T+0 reconciliation verifier, audit logs

clauses.ipTransfer: Full IP rights transfer to Gig Provider upon milestone sign-off.
clauses.confidentiality: Mutual NDA applies to proprietary source code and architecture.
clauses.governance: Immutable Dual-Signature Rule: Neither party can unilaterally alter timeline, cost, or features. Any modification requires cryptographic signatures from BOTH parties to mint a new on-chain Agreement version.

content.amendmentReason: Mutual scope expansion: Added Milestone 3 (Real-Time UPI & Multi-Currency FX Reconciliation), extended deadline by 15 days, and increased budget from ₹8,50,000 to ₹11,50,000.
